building: Beta Theta Pi (Beta Mu Chapter), Purdue University

identity_crosswalk.reason: Purdue's BuildingShapesZip4 feature FID 826 names BUILDING_N=Beta Theta Pi, BLDG_ABBR=SOBTP, ADDRESS=150 Littleton St, OWNER=GREEK. The Purdue Beta Mu chapter site identifies its chapter house at 150 Littleton Street, and Purdue BoilerLink lists the same address for Beta Theta Pi.
identity_crosswalk.master_asset_match: No reliable pre-existing asset match was present in the project library; this new asset explicitly represents GIS FID 826.
identity_crosswalk.chapter_address_crosswalk: GIS feature address and two chapter/university directory sources agree. This confirms the building identity/address but does not independently survey the doorway or identify which facade faces the public street.

asset.coordinate_frame: Meters, X east, Y north, Z up; campus project origin latitude 40.4274, longitude -86.9137.
asset.geometry_summary: Exact GIS perimeter walls with six individually named roof bands whose eaves are clipped to GIS cross-sections; a taller central tower roof/gable; three-level facade rows; a pale projecting bay with three vertically stacked arched glazed openings; an arched stone entry portal, shield plaque, steps, and GIS-footprint foundation cap.
asset.materials: Portable node materials: procedural warm red-brown brick, charcoal slate, limestone trim, cream-painted window frames, and dark reflective glass. No external material paths or packed image dependencies.
asset.interior: Not modeled. Purdue GIS references a private G: drive floorplan path, but no registered public plan was available. The official Beta housing record says four floors and a basement; it does not establish which levels are above grade or supply an interior plan, so interior geometry remains omitted.

sources.provider: Purdue University BuildingShapesZip4 ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0
sources.source_crs: EPSG:3857 / WKID 102100 (native layer geometry); a second preserved query snapshot explicitly transforms to EPSG:4326 / WKID 4326.

measurements.method: Transform the EPSG:4326 ring to project campus XY using X=(longitude + 86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude - 40.4274)*111040.0; compute polygon area, perimeter, and axis-aligned bounds in those local approximate meters.
measurements.area_note: The GIS Shape__Area value is in web-Mercator units, whose scale inflates ground area at this latitude. The local approximate area above is derived from the returned polygon ring, not copied from Shape__Area.

sources.uncertainty: The GIS footprint is authoritative for plan placement. The local coordinate transform is approximate, not a surveyed CRS. GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the three visible facade levels in official photos, while Extrution=12 has no interpretable units in the available metadata; neither provides a reliable height.

modelling_decisions.footprint: Used the full official FID 826 polygon ring after the documented campus-coordinate transform; wall perimeter and roof eaves follow this GIS geometry.
modelling_decisions.height: Wall height is modeled at approximately 9.3 m to represent three visible above-grade facade levels. The official Beta housing page lists four floors and a basement, but does not clarify whether the reported floor count includes the basement; this model choice is therefore photographic, not surveyed. Purdue GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=12 remain conflicting/unclear fields.
modelling_decisions.roof: Replaced the single continuous triangulated slab with six separate adjoining roof bands. Eaves are calculated from the GIS footprint cross-section at each band boundary to avoid floating oversize roof panels. A raised central tower ridge and visible front gable follow official photos 1 and 15. Ridge height, pitch and exact band layout are photo-based estimates, not surveyed.
modelling_decisions.windows_and_entrance: Three facade levels follow official photos 1, 11, 14, 15 and 16. The facade has a prominent pale projecting bay with three stacked arched openings, a tall central brick gable with high sash, and an arched stone entry with shield plaque. Positions relative to GIS footprint are approximate because no source geo-registers the pictured elevation to a compass bearing.
modelling_decisions.interior: Omitted because no registered floor plan was available to substantiate its geometry.
